## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Scientific effect

State whether this changes a target, map, proposal, acceptance rule, fitting or adaptation, seed allocation, budget, timing boundary, retained samples, estimator or diagnostic. Explain any protocol/configuration change and how historical results remain identifiable. For documentation-only changes, say so.

## Validation

List the relevant tests and reproduction checks, their outcomes, and platform limitations. For performance changes, identify the complete method comparison and recorded environment; retain unfavorable outcomes and distinguish quick execution checks from performance evidence.

## Evidence and provenance

Link any new protocol description or intentionally archived results. Confirm that no private data, environments, credentials or unrelated generated outputs are included.
